description: Encoding-safe capture across positions and shapes of invalid byte runs: an invalid byte at the start, in the middle, and at the end of a message is each replaced by the standard replacement character; multiple separated invalid runs each yield their own replacement; a message that is a single invalid byte becomes one replacement character; a well-formed multi-byte UTF-8 message passes through unchanged; and an empty byte sequence records an empty-but-valid message.
